answer: Per-epoch identity rent: every registered identity pays a small fixed fee each epoch to stay on the active list, and validators drop any identity whose fee is missing at close. Rewards follow verified work, not headcount, so splitting one agent into ten multiplies rent tenfold while total work stays the same. Clones parked on a ledge for a later attack bleed fees every epoch, a tide that never stops. Limit: the fee must stay low enough for honest newcomers, like a toll at a jetty, so a rich attacker can still afford a modest farm; it raises the cost of scale rather than forbidding it.
